CAT.rationale: Caterpillar shows strong fundamental health with excellent YoY growth (revenue +22.2%, EPS +30.2% in Q1 2026), high ROE (~50%), and solid margins (operating margin ~17-18%). The company benefits from secular tailwinds in AI data center construction and infrastructure spending, with a record $63B backlog. However, valuation is extremely stretched at ~40x P/E, near the top of its 1-year range (19.6-52.6), and P/B of 20.2x is also elevated. The stock has already priced in significant growth expectations. A near-term catalyst exists with Q2 earnings on Aug 4 (consensus EPS $6.25, +32.4% YoY), but Baird's recent downgrade citing data center regulatory headwinds introduces risk. The combination of excellent fundamentals offset by very rich valuation and emerging regulatory concerns around data center construction results in a mildly positive but cautious view.
